name: Pheniprazine
summary: Pheniprazine, formerly sold under the brand names Catron and Cavodil, is an irreversible and non-selective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine group that was used as an antidepressant to treat depression in the 1960s. It was also used in the treatment of angina pectoris and schizophrenia.

pharmacology.text: Pheniprazine is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI). Amphetamine has been detected as an active metabolite of pheniprazine in animals. Pheniprazine produces amphetamine- and psychostimulant-like effects at high doses in animals. The same is true of certain other MAOIs, including iproniazid, phenelzine, tranylcypromine, and pargyline, but not nialamide.

summaryZh: 苯異丙肼是一種有機化合物，化學式為C9H14N2，屬於聯氨類單胺氧化酶抑制劑，1960年代開始作為抗抑鬱藥使用。

sideEffects.en: MAO inhibitors of the hydrazine class can cause a dangerous rise in blood pressure when certain foods or medicines are taken, and they can cause liver damage, dizziness and sleep disturbance. This one in particular damaged the optic nerve and harmed vision.
sideEffects.zh: 肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑在攝取某些食物或藥物時，可能造成血壓危險升高，也可能引起肝損傷、頭暈與睡眠障礙。而這一種尤其會損傷視神經，傷害視力。
sideEffects.zhHans: 肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂在摄取某些食物或药物时，可能造成血压危险升高，也可能引起肝损伤、头晕与睡眠障碍。而这一种尤其会损伤视神经，伤害视力。

fact.en: It was withdrawn after it was found to damage the optic nerve, causing problems with colour vision and lasting visual loss in some patients.
fact.zh: 它在被發現會損傷視神經後撤市，部分病人出現色覺異常與持久的視力喪失。
fact.zhHans: 它在被发现会损伤视神经后撤市，部分病人出现色觉异常与持久的视力丧失。
